notes.note: Updated the Elicitation row for #3284: only a request that could elicit counts as in flight; on the 2026-07-28 era that is tools/call, prompts/get and resources/read (listings, ping and completion do not count), and on the 2025 era every request counts because the spec sets no limit on which request a server elicits during. Checked against NON_ELICITING_METHODS_2026 and clientRequestMethod in mcp-connection.ts, the SDK's EXTENDED_RESULT_TYPE_METHODS, and mcp-elicitation-connection.test.ts in both eras.
